caption: The drawing depicts three large floral motifs and one small star-like shape arranged on a beige, slightly textured background. The motifs are outlined in a muted reddish-brown color and feature pale teal, yellow, and light blue hues. The top left motif consists of a bulbous, symmetrical flower with lattice-patterned and solid segments, and curling elements at the bottom. The top right motif shows a vertically elongated flower with a diamond-patterned central area, surrounded by curved, pointed leaves and two small five-petaled flowers. The large motif at the bottom is a curved, stylized leaf or frond with parallel lines of teal and yellow following its contours, ending in a circular blue dot. The small star-like shape at the lower left has four blue diamond-shaped petals and a blue dot at the center, with the petals outlined in yellow. All shapes have a consistent outline and are evenly spaced, with the colored areas filling the interior spaces.
title: San Juan Capistrano Mission Altar Dome from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
